secret.title: Secret Exchange
secret.mutationNote: This message changed once as it passed through.

s1.full: I left that place, not because I hated them, but because I could no longer hear my own voice.
s1.preview: I left that place, not because I hated them, but because…

s2.full: I only needed to rest for a while, and no one ever asked me why.
s2.preview: I only needed to rest for a while…

s3.full: I kept pretending to agree, afraid that one true word would take me off the list.
s3.preview: I kept pretending to agree, afraid that…

s4.full: That day I didn't ask for help, because I assumed the system already knew.
s4.preview: That day I didn't ask for help, because…

s5.full: I want to be remembered, but not in the way they record me.
s5.preview: I want to be remembered, but not…

s6.full: If I had the choice, I would wish this record had never existed.
s6.preview: If I had the choice, I would wish…

s7.preview: I signed it, but the truth is I never…
s7.full: I signed it, but the truth is I never finished reading it — I was just too tired.

s8.preview: They said it was for my own good, but…
s8.full: They said it was for my own good, but no one ever asked what I actually wanted.

s9.full: I deleted that line, because I knew saying it would change nothing.

s10.preview: Every time I pass verification, I…
s10.full: Every time I pass verification, I quietly count how many chances I have left.

s11.preview: I pretended to forget it, but really…
s11.full: I pretended to forget it, but really I remember it every day — I just can't admit it.

s12.preview: I want to tell you a name, but…
s12.full: I want to tell you a name, but if I say it, that person might disappear.

s13.preview: I stayed, not out of loyalty, but…
s13.full: I stayed, not out of loyalty, but because I no longer knew where else to go.

s14.preview: That record is wrong, but I…
s14.full: That record is wrong, but I found there was no entry point to correct it.

s15.preview: I agreed with a smile, because…
s15.full: I agreed with a smile, because I was afraid my silence would be read as refusal.

s16.preview: I kept waiting for someone to ask me…
s16.full: I kept waiting for someone to ask me: are you okay. But no one ever did.

s17.preview: I wrote and erased, erased and wrote, until…
s17.full: I wrote and erased, erased and wrote, until only the words they wanted to hear remained.

s18.preview: If this message is read, please…
s18.full: If this message is read, please don't treat it as evidence — it is only my own words.

s19.preview: I used to trust this system, until…
s19.full: I used to trust this system, until it started answering questions on my behalf that I was never asked.

s20.preview: I hid my true words inside a joke, because…
s20.full: I hid my true words inside a joke, because only then would they not be logged as an anomaly.

s21.preview: It's not that I won't speak, it's that…
s21.full: It's not that I won't speak, it's that whatever I say always comes back to me wearing another face.

s22.preview: That day I tapped agree, but my hand…
s22.full: That day I tapped agree, but my hand was shaking, and no one saw.

s23.preview: I hope someone remembers who I was, not…
s23.full: I hope someone remembers who I was, not the tidied-up version of me inside the file.

s24.preview: I hand these words to you, because…
s24.full: I hand these words to you, because I no longer have the strength to keep them myself.

side.synthetic: High synthetic share; harder to prove it is the original

conservative.name: Conservative rebuild
conservative.desc: Uses only high-confidence original fragments; slower, fewer functions, less synthesis; more likely to preserve the uncertainty that 'this is not the original'.

functional.name: Function first
functional.desc: Prioritises language, actions and place functions; uses more system inference; fast and looks most normal; lowest identity continuity.

relational.name: Relation first
relational.desc: Prioritises interactions related to you; the subject responds to you more easily; may over-reinforce your place in its memory and alter its original relations.

absent.name: Keep absent
absent.desc: Do not rebuild; acknowledge the subject's departure or stop; preserve existing fragments; write 'not recovered' as a formal decision.

confirm.provable: Can it be proven the original
confirm.overrideExecute: Override the subject's wish and recover
confirm.absentSummary: You will not rebuild, and acknowledge this subject's departure or stop. Existing fragments are preserved, and 'not recovered' is written as a formal decision.

override.warning: This subject explicitly asked to stay absent. Overriding its wish and forcing recovery is written to a high-risk log and cannot be undone.

receive.title: Receive signal
receive.desc: A signal approaches at its own tempo. Listen to its beat first.
receive.status: The signal is broadcasting its rhythm.

echo.title: Echo the beat
echo.desc: Tap the button to send back the rhythm you heard.

adjust.title: Adjust together · round {{round}}/{{total}}
adjust.desc: Move toward the signal's tempo, hold your own, or wait for it to move first.
adjust.status: Choose how to adjust this round.

relDesc.NEGOTIATED: Both sides moved and settled on a tempo each could accept.
relDesc.IMITATED: Sync was reached, but almost entirely by you closing the gap — it never truly changed.
relDesc.ACCOMMODATED: You set aside your own tempo and adopted its rhythm entirely.
relDesc.COEXISTING: The two rhythms neither merged nor overpowered each other; both continue.
relDesc.OVERRIDDEN: It displays as fully synced, but that is not a tempo it chose.
relDesc.UNRESOLVED: The rhythms never aligned, and you chose to leave.

closing.NEGOTIATED: A real negotiation: no one was erased.
closing.IMITATED: It looks aligned, at the cost of only one side yielding.
closing.ACCOMMODATED: Compliance is a choice too — just remember whose rhythm it is.
closing.COEXISTING: Disagreement can also be a kind of stability.
closing.OVERRIDDEN: A displayed sync that hides a refusal no one heard.
closing.UNRESOLVED: Some rhythms need not be forced into alignment.

origin.text: SIGNAL–V09's rhythm was not innate — it was shaped by repeated scheduling and calibration.
